test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 15 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. Besides, it is also an occasion to commemorate the signing of the Ramsar Convention on wetlands in 1971.

B. World Wetland Day is celebrated on 2 February to raise awareness about the critical importance of wetlands.

C. Unfortunately, these valuable wetlands are disappearing three times faster than the forest areas.

D. The Convention upholds the wetlands as the world's most economically valuable ecosystems.
solution:
The correct answer is **'BADC'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some __grammatical or contextual __connections between them. Also, the first sentence of a passage is usually independent and introduces a topic. The second one provides more information about it. **

__
 
• **Sentence B** is the independent sentence and introduces the topic which relates to how a certain day is celebrated to raise awareness regarding the importance of wetlands. 
 
• So, sentence **B **is the first sentence after rearrangement. 
 
• **Sentence A** describes how that particular day mentioned in sentence B is also important for commemorating a certain convention. Thus, to maintain continuity, sentence **A ** comes in the **second** position. Hence, **A follows B.**__
 
• **Sentence D **which explains the importance of the convention should come **after sentence A**, to maintain continuity on the topic. 
 
• **Sentence C** is the concluding statement of the passage as it provides further information regarding how despite the critical importance of wetlands they are disappearing. 

Thus, the correct order after rearrangement is **option 1 i.e. BADC.**

***So, the correct paragraph is : (B) World Wetland Day is celebrated on 2 February to raise awareness about the critical importance of wetlands. (A) Besides, it is also an occasion to commemorate the signing of the Ramsar Convention on wetlands in 1971. (D) The Convention upholds the wetlands as the world's most economically valuable ecosystems. (C) Unfortunately, these valuable wetlands are disappearing three times faster than the forest areas.***
